paite: Huai thilte nung in, Tiberias tuipi ah anungzuite kiang ah Jesu akilak nawn a; hichibang in amah mah akilak hi.
heading: Tiberias Tuipi Ah Jesu Akilak

paite: Simon Peter leh Thomas, Didum achih uh, Galili gam a Kana a Nathanael, Zebedai tapa nihte, anungzui dang nihte toh a-omkhawm uhi.

Simon Peter in akiang uah, "Ngasa man ding in ka kuan dek," achi a, amau akiang ah, "Kou leng na kiang ah ka hong sam ding uh," achi uhi. Apawtkhia ua, long ah atuang ua, huai zan in bangmah aman kei uhi.
Phalvak in piautak ah Jesu ava dingh a; himahleh anungzuite'n Jesu ahi chih athei kei uhi.
Jesu'n akiang uah, "Naute aw, nek ding banghiam na nei uhia?" achi hi. Amau akiang ah, "Nei lou," chi in adawng uhi.
Huan akiang uah, "Long sik taklam ah len pai le uchin na man ding uh," achi hi. Apai ua, ngasa atam ziak in akaikhe zou kei uhi.
Huchi in nungzui Jesu itpa'n Peter kiang ah, "Toupa ei ve," achi hi. Huchi in Toupa ahi chih Simon Peter in atheih in, apuanak tungsilh ateng a, amah vuaktang a om ahi a, tuipi ah atawmkheta hi.
Himahleh nungzuite'n long neuchik in, len ngasa a dim toh kai kawm in ahon zuan ua, gam a kipan in agamla ngal kei ua, tong zanih hiam phet ahi.
Huan gam a ahong suahtak un, meihol a mei tohsa atung a ngasa leh tanghou emsa amu uhi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Tu in na ngasa mat uh akhen hon latou un," achi hi.
Huchi in Simon Peter ava tuang a, ngasa lian pipi a dim tui gei ah ahon kaikhia a, zakhat sawmnga-le-thum apha hi; huchi lawmlawm in tam mahleh len akek kei hi.
Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Zing an hong ne un," achi hi. Nungzuite lak ah kuamah in akiang ah, "Kua na hia?" chi in adong ngam kei uh. Toupa ahi chih athei uhi.
Huan Jesu ahong pai a, tanghou ala a, akiang uah apia a, ngasate leng huchibang mah in ape sam hi.
Huai tuh Jesu misi lak a kipan athohnawn nung a, anungzuite kiang a akilak thumveina ahi.

Huan zing an anek khit un, Simon Peter kiang ah Jesu'n, "Simon, Johan tapa, nang hiaite sang in kei na hon itzaw hia?" achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Hi, Toupa, ka hon it chih na thei hi,” achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka belamnoute vak in," achi hi.
heading: Peter Kiang A Jesu Thu Nanungte

paite: Huan anihveina ding in akiang ah, "Simon, Johan tapa, nang kei na hon it hia?" achi nawn hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Hi, Toupa, ka hon it chih na thei hi,” achi nawn hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka belamte ching in," achi hi.

Huan athumveina ding in akiang ah, "Simon, Johan tapa, nang kei na hon it hia?" achi hi. Huan thumveina a nang kei na hon it hia? chi a akiang a agen ziak in Peter alungkham a, akiang ah, "Toupa, bangkim na thei a, ka hon it chih na thei hi,” achi hi. Jesu'n akiang ah, "Ka belamte vak in."

"Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, na naupan lai in na tai ah na kigak a, na utna peuh ah na hoh a; himahleh na upat hun chiang in na khut na zak ding a, midang in ahon gaksak ding ua, na utlouhna lam ah ahon kai ding uh," achi hi.
Huai thu bangchidan a si in ahia Pathian apahtawi ding, chih theihsakna ding a agen ahi. Huai agen khit in akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi hi.
Huai khit in Peter akihei a, Jesu nungzui itpa, nitak an nek lai a a-awm ngai a hong awnphei a, "Amansak dingpa kua pen ahia?" chipa'n, amau hon zui amu hi.
heading: Jesu Leh Nungzui Dang

paite: Peter in amah amuhtak in, Jesu kiang ah, "Toupa, hiai mi'n bang ahih dia?" achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Ka hong pai nawn tan a om nilouh ding in deih leng, huai nang bang lunghimoh zenzen? Nang hon zui in," achi hi.

Huchi in huai nungzuipa si lou ding in athu unaute lak ah athangta a; himahleh Jesu'n asi kei ding chih akiang ah agen kei a, "K'ong pai nawn tan a om nilouh ding in deih leng, huai nang bang lunghimoh zenzen?" chi lel ahi zaw hi.
Huai nungzuipa, "Hiai thu theisakpa leh gelhpa ahi; huan athu theihsak adik chih i thei uhi."
Huan hiaite lou leng Jesu thilhih dang tampi a-om lai a; huaite gelh vek ding hileh, laibu gelh ding tengteng khovel ah leng tazou in ka gingta kei hi. Amen.
heading: Thukhitna
